team.name: Magdalena Lang
team.shortBio: Strategy, operations, fundraising. Background spans medicine and biomedical neuroscience (TU Munich), genome editing research at Harvard Medical School, and doctoral research at Boston Children’s Hospital. Turns deep bioprocess pain into a fundable product wedge.

team.name: Lucas Mair
team.shortBio: AI, automation, product. MD-PhD candidate at TU Munich / Helmholtz Munich. Builds the closed-loop intelligence layer connecting biological readouts, decision-making, and existing lab automation infrastructure.

team.name: Constantin Convalexius, MD
team.shortBio: Physician and researcher building physical AI for life-science laboratories, connecting experimental design, automated execution, and adaptive learning.

team.name: Thejas Nagaraju, PhD
team.shortBio: Biotech go-to-market, partnerships, scale-up. Trained molecular biologist with 8+ years in life sciences and a track record building early-stage health ventures, translating bench research into commercial propositions. De-risks commercial adoption through CDMO/pharma access and pilot-to-partnership strategy.

team.name: Cheng-Wei Liao
